title: crataegus monogyna f. semperflorens
intro: Crataegus monogyna f. semperflorens, commonly known as Evergreen Hawthorn, is a subform of the hawthorn plant species Crataegus monogyna, known for its year-round green foliage. The health benefits of Evergreen Hawthorn include its potential to reduce blood pressure and cholesterol levels, as well as its ability to improve heart health by preventing the formation of blood clots. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against oxidative stress and inflammation in the body. The bioactive constituents of Evergreen Hawthorn include flavonoids, such as quercetin and epicatechin, as well as oligomeric proanthocyanidins (OPCs), which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
